name: Sean Audain
story: Sean Audain of Wellington City Council presented “Geospatial in a Smart City” at the 2017 New Zealand Esri User Conference. His presentation provides a named connection between council GIS, urban data and the smart-city programmes that were broadening the use of spatial platforms beyond specialist GIS teams.
